<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''ディバ''' ''Diva'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HZ059|Dance, Quaxly! The Blue Medali Step!]]''.

She is a {{wp|street dance}}r who met [[Dot]], [[Liko]], and [[Roy]] in [[Medali]]. After seeing {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}}'s enthusiasm, she challenged Dot to a dance competition. After seeing Quaxly's resourcefulness, she revealed to the group where to find [[Larry]] in the city.
{{-}}
